name: CRCKit
description: Browser-based CRC checksum calculator supporting CRC-8 (1-Wire), CRC-8 (DVB-S2), CRC-8 (SMBus), CRC-16, CRC-24 (OpenPGP), CRC-24 (BLE), CRC-24 (Intlkn), CRC-32, CRC-32C, CRC-32 (JamCRC), CRC-32 (BZIP2), CRC-64 (ECMA), CRC-82 (DARC), and more. All computation is local — no data is transmitted.
headline: CRC-32 Checksum Calculator
featureList: Text checksum, File checksum, Hex output, Base64 output, Binary output, Checksum history, Random checksum generation
